g.text: │ -h, --help show this help message and exit │
│ --run-name STR Unique identifier for this training run required │
│ --seed INT Random seed for reproducibility (alias: --random-seed) default: 42 │
│ --output-dir PATH Where checkpoints and logs are written default: output │
│ --checkpoint-steps [INT [...]] Steps at which to save a checkpoint default: [] │
│ --extra-kwargs DICT Arbitrary extra config passed to the trainer default: {} │
│ --student.model.name STR Checkpoint name or HuggingFace ID default: qwen-1b │
│ --student.model.num-layers INT Number of transformer blocks default: 24 │
│ --data.path PATH Path to the dataset directory default: data │
│ --data.shuffle {True,False} Shuffle the training set each epoch default: True │
╭─ compile: torch.compile settings (pass --no-compile to disable) (optional, enabled by default) ────────────╮
│ --compile.mode STR Compilation mode (default, reduce-overhead, default: default │
│ --compile.fullgraph {True,False} Require the entire model to be capturable in a single default: False │
╭─ wandb: Weights & Biases logging. (optional, default: None) ───────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --wandb.project STR W&B project name default: prime-rl │
│ --wandb.entity STR|None W&B team or user; defaults to the logged-in user default: None │
│ --wandb.tags [STR [...]] Tags attached to the run default: [] │
